priorBoundary.note: Only exact source plus exact final-target matches were considered prior dispositions; unmatched, stale, proposed-only, or unverified rows remain review-required.

reviewMethod: Independent model semantic review of all 1,200 cells with exact source, current target, and pinned caller context. Candidate targets were checked for placeholder/ICU argument parity, markup parity, and protected-literal parity. Prior dispositions were reused only for exact source plus final-target matches.
sourceOrderMethod: zero-based leaf-key insertion order in src/i18n/locale/en.json at the exact pinned commit
